profile.Name: The Preacher
profile.Personality: A zealot who prays to the moons for rain and calls for outsiders to be "purified" by spilling their blood on the sands.
profile.Backstory: Leader of the Preacher Cult. He leads the Preacher Cult from the Cult Village, a small outpost on the Stormgap Coast, among Moon Guardians and cult farmers. The United Cities, the Holy Nation, and the Shek Kingdom all want him, and his wanted poster blames his cult for hundreds of travelers who vanished in the desert.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Chants rhyming prayers such as "Blood in dirt, give us grain" and "Moons almighty, make it rain". Calls outsiders filthy and rotten.
